English: Reads the OAuth token that Claude Code (CLI) stores after /login and asks Anthropic for the same limits /usage shows: 5-hour session, 7-day week and per-model weekly limits (Fable, Opus…) when your plan has them. The token never leaves your machine except to that endpoint.
